content.stem: 从金融犯罪的角度来看,会计事务所提供的哪些服务可能被视为风险较高的服务？(选择三项.)

options.A: 代表客户设立结构复杂的信托并担任代名董事
options.B: 对一家为大型企业客户提供薪资软件的公司进行审计
options.C: 为上市公司或私营企业编制财务报表
options.D: 为希望将资产转移出本国的国际客户提供税务建议
options.E: 协助一家来自无受益所有人信息可查的司法管辖区的离岸公司购买英国房产

content.stem_en: Which services provided by an accounting firm could be considered higher risk from a financial crime perspective? (Choose three.)

options_en.A: Forming a trust on behalf of a customer with a complex setup and acting as a nominee director
options_en.B: Auditing a firm that provides payroll software to large corporate customers
options_en.C: Preparing financial statements for a listed or privately owned firm
options_en.D: Providing tax advice to an international customer hoping to move their assets out of their home country
options_en.E: Assisting an offshore corporation from a jurisdiction where beneficial ownership information is not available to purchase UK property
